commit f542e7e3205bfb654e568af251ce2dcdee0877b2
Author:     Kai Engert <kaie@kuix.de>
AuthorDate: Fri May 22 14:22:33 2026 +0200
Commit:     Kai Engert <kaie@kuix.de>
CommitDate: Fri May 22 14:22:33 2026 +0200

    Bug 2041666 - Fix macos installer bustage. r=bustage

diff --git a/mail/installer/Makefile.in b/mail/installer/Makefile.in
index 13b76207dcb..f626747c48a 100644
--- a/mail/installer/Makefile.in
+++ b/mail/installer/Makefile.in
@@ -136,20 +136,13 @@ NON_OMNIJAR_FILES = defaults/messenger/mailViews.dat
 
 include $(topsrcdir)/toolkit/mozapps/installer/packager.mk
 
+BINPATH = $(MOZ_PKG_BINPATH)
 ifeq (Darwin,$(OS_TARGET))
-BINPATH = $(_BINPATH)
-DEFINES += -DAPPNAME='$(_APPNAME)'
-else
-# Every other platform just winds up in dist/bin
-BINPATH = bin
+DEFINES += -DAPPNAME='$(MOZ_MACBUNDLE_NAME)'
 endif
 DEFINES += -DBINPATH='$(BINPATH)'
 
-ifeq (cocoa,$(MOZ_WIDGET_TOOLKIT))
-RESPATH = $(_RESPATH)
-else
-RESPATH = $(BINPATH)
-endif
+RESPATH = $(MOZ_PKG_RESPATH)
 DEFINES += -DRESPATH='$(RESPATH)'
 
 LPROJ_ROOT = $(firstword $(subst -, ,$(AB_CD)))
@@ -194,11 +187,7 @@ PKGCOMP_FIND_OPTS =
 else
 PKGCOMP_FIND_OPTS = -L
 endif
-ifeq (Darwin, $(OS_ARCH))
-FINDPATH = $(_APPNAME)/Contents/MacOS
-else
-FINDPATH=bin
-endif
+FINDPATH = $(MOZ_PKG_BINPATH)
 
 package-compare:: $(MOZ_PKG_MANIFEST)
 	cd $(DIST); find $(PKGCOMP_FIND_OPTS) '$(FINDPATH)' -type f | sort > bin-list.txt
title: Bug 2041666 - Fix macos installer bustage. r=bustage
